Appearing on Stephen A. Smith's radio show shortly after the news came out, Trump said that Huang would "end up on his feet."

headlines.name: Nvidia
headlines.headline: A selloff, a POTUS, or a recession: What really made Nvidia bring Jensen Huang back as CEO?
headlines.description: The instant the news hit the wires Monday morning that Jensen Huang was back in the job as Nvidia CEO, shares of the AI chipmaker surged 29% in premarket trading. They went on to notch their best session in more than 20 years, while the broad-market S&P 500 and the tech-heavy Nasdaq jumped about 4.7% and 6.5% respectively.

headlines.name: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler for $44B in cyber mega-merger
headlines.headline: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler for $44B in cyber mega-merger
headlines.description: CrowdStrike will buy Zscaler for nearly $44 billion in stock , in what could be the largest-ever cybersecurity deal, as demand for their expertise surges on AI hacking fears. The announcement aims to generate synergies between two of cyber’s pure-play titans after a wave of outages at airlines, banks, and government agencies prompted last week’s ouster of the White House cyber director .

sources.title: CrowdStrike is buying Zscaler to create a cybersecurity giant built for the era of AI agents
sources.description: Two cybersecurity companies are coming together in one of the industry’s biggest ever mergers. On Monday, November 23, CrowdStrike announced that it will purchase Zscaler in an all-stock deal. The transaction values Zscaler at a whopping $43.9 billion, with the company’s shareholders getting 1.135 CrowdStrike common shares (Nasdaq: CRWD) for each Zscaler share (Nasdaq: ZS) they own.
